CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_key ON public.users USING btree (email)
submissions: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX submissions_pkey ON public.submissions USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX idx_submissions_user_id ON public.submissions USING btree (user_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_submissions_status ON public.submissions USING btree (status)
CREATE INDEX idx_submissions_payment_status ON public.submissions USING btree (payment_status)
rights_packages: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rights_packages_pkey ON public.rights_packages USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rights_packages_submission_id_key ON public.rights_packages USING btree (submission_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rights_packages_catalog_id_key ON public.rights_packages USING btree (catalog_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_rights_packages_submission_id ON public.rights_packages USING btree (submission_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_rights_packages_catalog_id ON public.rights_packages USING btree (catalog_id)
payment_fulfillments: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_fulfillments_pkey ON public.payment_fulfillments USING btree (stripe_checkout_session_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX pf_one_accepted_per_submission ON public.payment_fulfillments USING btree (submission_ref) WHERE (outcome = 'accepted'::text)
CREATE INDEX pf_submission_id_idx ON public.payment_fulfillments USING btree (submission_id)
CREATE INDEX pf_retry_candidates_idx ON public.payment_fulfillments USING btree (created_at) WHERE (fulfillment_status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_progress'::text, 'failed'::text]))

CREATE INDEX pf_attention_idx ON public.payment_fulfillments USING btree (created_at) WHERE ((anomaly_status = 'open'::text) OR (fulfillment_status = ANY (ARRAY['needs_reconciliation'::text, 'failed'::text])))
creator_record_artifacts: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX creator_record_artifacts_pkey ON public.creator_record_artifacts USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX creator_record_artifacts_submission_id_key ON public.creator_record_artifacts USING btree (submission_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX creator_record_artifacts_record_id_key ON public.creator_record_artifacts USING btree (record_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX creator_record_artifacts_storage_path_key ON public.creator_record_artifacts USING btree (storage_path)
creator_record_artifact_uat: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX creator_record_artifact_uat_pkey ON public.creator_record_artifact_uat USING btree (submission_id)
payment_legacy_session_policy: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX payment_legacy_session_policy_pkey ON public.payment_legacy_session_policy USING btree (singleton)

users: CREATE TRIGGER update_users_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
submissions: CREATE TRIGGER update_submissions_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.submissions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
rights_packages: CREATE TRIGGER update_rights_packages_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.rights_packages FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
creator_record_artifacts: CREATE TRIGGER creator_record_artifacts_guard BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.creator_record_artifacts FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION creator_record_artifacts_guard()

users: FOREIGN KEY (id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
submissions: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
rights_packages: FOREIGN KEY (submission_id) REFERENCES submissions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
payment_fulfillments: FOREIGN KEY (submission_id) REFERENCES submissions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
